plan.summary: BRO-5632: cite two weekly running costs that were labelled trade-reported but cited nothing (the site showed them as estimates). Parade 2023 ($659K) and Sweeney Todd 2023 ($840K) are stated in the Broadway Journal articles already in each record's sources, both before royalties. Five other uncited figures found in their own sources are not running costs (Cabaret's $1.5M is all-in spending in its first seven weeks; Here Lies Love, Once Upon a One More Time and Titanique are break-even grosses) and stay estimates; Maybe Happy Ending's $765K traces only to Wikipedia.
